tools.name: wget
tools.version:
GNU Wget 1.25.0 hecho en linux-gnu.

-cares +digest -gpgme +https +ipv6 +iri +large-file -metalink +nls 
+ntlm +opie +psl +ssl/gnutls 

Wgetrc: 
    /etc/wgetrc (sistema)
Locale: 
    /usr/share/locale 
Compila: 
    gcc -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DSYSTEM_WGETRC="/etc/wgetrc" 
    -DLOCALEDIR="/usr/share/locale" -I. -I../lib -I../lib 
    -I/usr/include/p11-kit-1 -DHAVE_LIBGNUTLS -DNDEBUG -march=x86-64 
    -mtune=generic -O2 -pipe -fno-plt -fexceptions 
    -Wp,-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3 -Wformat -Werror=format-security 
    -fstack-clash-protection -fcf-protection -fno-omit-frame-pointer 
    -mno-omit-leaf-frame-pointer -g 
    -ffile-prefix-map=/build/wget/src=/usr/src/debug/wget -flto=auto 
Enlaza: 
    gcc -I/usr/include/p11-kit-1 -DHAVE_LIBGNUTLS -DNDEBUG 
    -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -O2 -pipe -fno-plt -fexceptions 
    -Wp,-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3 -Wformat -Werror=format-security 
    -fstack-clash-protection -fcf-protection -fno-omit-frame-pointer 
    -mno-omit-leaf-frame-pointer -g 
    -ffile-prefix-map=/build/wget/src=/usr/src/debug/wget -flto=auto 
    -Wl,-O1 -Wl,--sort-common -Wl,--as-needed -Wl,-z,relro -Wl,-z,now 
    -Wl,-z,pack-relative-relocs -flto=auto -lpcre2-8 -luuid -lidn2 
    -lnettle -lgnutls -lz -lpsl ../lib/libgnu.a 
    /usr/lib/libunistring.so
